name: inherit-lab
description: Hand-authored fixture for declared base types (§4.4): a base this run declares becomes an F# `inherit`, the diamond and the redeclaration F# admits, a generic base applied at the inherit, a class base, and the bases that stay flattened - one with no F# name, one bound by a shipped package under a name this run did not declare, and a utility-type base. Tracked in git, no npm install, so the goldens pin the mapping under the live compiler and the compile gate proves each arrangement is legal F#.
